mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during easing cycles.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two months, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that elevates corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both rise >0.5% MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k signals labor market tightness that triggers inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 200k, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% for three months) signals central bank tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% for three months, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong supply-side expansion that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO and GDPC1 both rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 3.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market tightness that fuels wage growth and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
